source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - USA and Canada (November 2025)
source.content:
We are happy to announce we have a new Senior Delegate, Abhimanyu Singhal, for USA & Canada. 


Abhimanyu (“Manu”) was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our Motion about Senior Delegates.


We extend our support and best wishes to Manu in fulfilling his new responsibilities. His term as Senior Delegate starts on November 18, 2025.


Manu was among two applicants we had for the Senior Delegate USA & Canada role. The candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dWywBP07-x9xrt69JN1O3Q_FxNakLaUB).


In addition to Manu, the other applicant for USA & Canada was:

* Sarah Strong

translation.title: 高级代表任命公告：美国和加拿大（2025 年 11 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Abhimanyu Singhal 将担任美国和加拿大地区的新任高级代表。

WCA 董事会依照高级代表动议第 4 节，经投票选出 Abhimanyu（“Manu”）。

我们支持 Manu 履行新的职责，也祝他工作顺利。他的高级代表任期自 2025 年 11 月 18 日开始。

本次美国和加拿大地区高级代表职位共有两人申请，其中包括 Manu。申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1dWywBP07-x9xrt69JN1O3Q_FxNakLaUB)查看。

除 Manu 外，另一名申请人为：

* Sarah Strong
